risks: No participants and no personal data; the risk is that the map is read as a ranking of study quality, which it is not.
consent: Not applicable: published studies only; one courtesy email per study to authors for unreported choices.
data: Published data; the charting spreadsheet is shared with the report.
equity: PROGRESS-Plus: the map records whether studies included and reported older adults in care homes, people vaccinated in pharmacies (often missing from registers) and people with cognitive impairment, so that the regional protocol does not repeat their exclusion.
effectiveness: Informs the protocol's methods choices; it does not estimate effectiveness.
efficiency: A registrar's three months and library support.
partnerships: Agency laboratories, the regional university, sentinel practice leads and an older people's forum representative.
rebPath: No research ethics review for a review of published literature; the protocol is registered (OSR-2026-7731). The later test-negative study will need its own review.
limitations: Reporting is not practice; database and language coverage.
summary: No participants; equity items charted so that the protocol does not repeat exclusions.
